crossRefs.note: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry;

translations.web: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry;
translations.bsb: Men do not despise the thief if he steals to satisfy his hunger.
translations.kjv: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
